overview_description.description: QURB Service is an online marketplace for services which means users can provide and consume services on this platform. Users who have skills and want to sell them by offering them online can use this platform to earn some money as well as be a part of the betterment of society. We have started this initiative as a small step towards a bigger and larger prospect. Since most of under-developed countries are rich in terms of talented youth they don't have the right infrastructure and resources.
